title: [high] Chrome 156 updates fix 426 security bugs, 11 of them critical (none known exploited)
summary: Google s Chrome 156 stable release (156.0.8078.47, .48 on some Windows/Mac) fixed 353 security issues, including six critical bugs in Skia, Accessibility, CSS, Paint and WebRTC. On Oct 27 a follow-up update (156.0.8078.73/.74) fixed 52 more, four of them critical (FileSystem, FileAPI, Skia, Layout).
